main.description: DME encrypted message envelope. Stored on PDS, indexed by AppView, polled via gateway.

queueId.description: Hash of the ratchet state at the time of encryption. Used as the lookup key for blind polling.

payload.description: Base64url-encoded ciphertext. Symmetrically encrypted with the message key derived from the current ratchet state.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the envelope was created.

ratchetEpoch.description: Optional ratchet epoch number. Allows skipping ahead when the recipient polls future queueIds.
